The texture source.

scaleAdjust float

The raw pixel height of the font. Can be used to apply a global scale or metric to font usages.

FontStore(IRenderer, IResourceStore<TextureUpload>, float, TextureFilteringMode)

Construct a font store with a custom filtering mode to be added to a parent font store via osu.Framework.IO.Stores.FontStore.AddStore(osu.Framework.Graphics.Textures.ITextureStore). All fonts that use the specified filter mode should be nested inside this store to make optimal use of texture atlases.

Methods

AddStore(ITextureStore)

Adds a nested texture store to use during osu.Framework.Graphics.Textures.Texture lookup if not found in this store.

public override void AddStore(ITextureStore store)

Parameters

store ITextureStore

The store to add.

Remarks

Of note, nested stores will use their own sources and not include any sources added via osu.Framework.Graphics.Textures.TextureStore.AddTextureSource(osu.Framework.IO.Stores.IResourceStore{osu.Framework.Graphics.Textures.TextureUpload}).

Remarks

Lookup sources can be implemented easily using a osu.Framework.Graphics.Textures.TextureLoaderStore to provide the final osu.Framework.Graphics.Textures.TextureUpload.
